title.narrative: Partnership for Affordable Healthcare Access and Longevity (PAHAL)

description.narrative: (India): PAHAL is USAID/India's flagship financing platform aimed at improving access to affordable and quality healthcare for the economically disadvantaged. PAHAL leverages private sector resources to enable greater social impact. PAHAL leverages inclusive business models providing primary and secondary healthcare; promotes financing models for sustainable health solutions; builds operational efficiencies/system strengthening; reduces out-of-pocket expenditures; deploys innovative technologies, solutions, and partners for patient-centric healthcare; and improves access to affordable and quality healthcare for the poor and vulnerable. The program also supports several innovative private sector and finance models to support USAID's work to end Tuberculosis in India...With FY 2021 funds, this activity will design, structure, and implement pay-for-performance models aimed at linking financial incentives to improved TB testing and treatment outcomes and alternate financing mechanisms to reduce out-of-pocket expenditures by TB patients and mobilize additional resources to support these models...It is affirmed that the funds are doing cross-cutting HSS work with Health funding in program areas not captured in the FY 2021 Operational Plan. .While the mechanism in only allocated TB funds in FY 2021, it has received FP/RH and MCH funds in the past, and is a health systems strengthening implemening mechanism focused on innovative financing. ... .. .
